author: Atheyna
body:
Got feedback you would like to give on a map, but you have no idea where to leave this feedback? Whether negative or positive, this is the place to leave exactly what you think about particular maps.

For example, If I disliked the map Consilium, I could leave a comment on this thread as to exactly why I had an aversion towards Consilium.

Other Map Developing threads and websites you may wish to visit.

> Map Building FAQ - http://avicus.net/forums/7b06d685d
> Map District - http://avicus.net/forums/f136120d9
> Map Development AMA - http://avicus.net/forums/eff6ca1d0
> How to become a Map Developer - http://avicus.net/forums/8693fd9ec
> Avicus YAML Documentation - http://docs.avicus.net/
> Map Development Twitter - https://twitter.com/AvicusMD
> How to Package a Map - http://avicus.net/forums/c55047443

Map Developers will be checking this thread constantly, and we will make revisions on specific maps based on the points users leave on this thread (If they are legitimate points)

replies.body:
I highly suggest you to remove Siege from the rotations.
Why?
- The map is way to big for the amount of the players the map usually gets. (People leave the map because they don't like it)
- The gameplay is boring because as defenders can't get out of the base, there is a lack of PvP in the middle of the map.
- Kits aren't too original, they look basic and potion effects aren't taken in count for most of them.
- It gets boring because the main objective of the map is getting into their castle, this is way too easy because as the map is huge, it's easy not to be noticed so you can score as many point you want. You also get tired of going over and over to the sample place.
Please, take this in count!

replies.author: Goodnighht
replies.body:
Walls....
  • There are some maps that almost no one likes, such as Sandstorm.
  • There are also a lot that most people don't like, such as Oz, Scarecrow.
  • Sandstorm just needs to be removed honestly. There's not enough wood, iron, or coal. Along with the terrain is not good for PvP.
  • Oz, I personally don't like much, but this is just my opinion. Everything in middle is so close together, you can get everything in a matter of 2-3 minutes. Then it leaves everyone else with nothing good from middle.
  • Scarecrow just simply has too many diamonds, not enough iron, or coal. Along with that Red team has an advantage. There is a extra sharp 2 or 3 Sapling, and a rose that is fire aspect 2. Not fun to play against that when you are 2v1 or even 3v1.
